title: Slovenia election too close to call as PM claims victory in neck-and-neck race
summary: Slovenian Prime Minister Robert Golob claimed victory on Sunday after a tight parliamentary election, with near-final results showing his liberal party at 28.54% ahead of Janez Jansa’s conservatives on 28.17%. The outcome gives Golob 29 seats to Jansa’s 28 in the 90-seat parliament.
